neighbours.label: being switched off or disabled (disabled, paused, deactivated, muted): a feature or process put in an off state
fire: Since the update, location tracking on my phone has been disabled.
The download was paused because the battery was low.
Your account has been deactivated after six months of inactivity.
During the exam, all notifications are muted on the tablets.
Two-factor login was disabled by the administrator last night.
The game is paused until the second player reconnects.
For safety, the elevator is disabled during a fire alarm.
The microphone was muted for the rest of the meeting.
quiet: Since the update, location tracking on my phone works much better.
The download was slow because the hotel wifi was weak.
Your account has been active for more than six years now.
During the exam, all students sit at separate tables.
Two-factor login was explained by the administrator last night.
The game is popular with players in Brazil and Korea.
For safety, the elevator is inspected once a month.
The microphone was placed in the middle of the table.

notes: Top examples: disabled, paused, freeze, switched (on!), masked. Probe: 'disabled' 0.61, 'paused' 0.27, 'frozen' 0.11; 'enabled' itself fired 0.20, so the pole may track the enable/disable state rather than only 'off'.
